== Description ==

[[Bryan Mischke]] (left, grey hoodie and backwards 1972 cap) playing [[Sam Tashima]] (center, grey Nike quarter-zip) with [[Joe Horbey]] (right, dark denim shirt) at the next table at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
